title: Low-Cal Greek Chickpea Stew
subtitle: with Eggplant and Feta Dippers
description: Enjoy low-cal comfort with this hearty vegetarian stew. Simmer eggplant and chickpeas in an oregano-scented tomato sauce, then serve with feta-topped wholemeal rolls for scooping up the delicious sauce.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut the eggplant into 2cm chunks (see Kitchen 101). Thinly slice the zucchini. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Drain and rinse the chickpeas.

Cook eggplant: Heat 3 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the eggplant, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until golden. Season with salt and pepper. Add the garlic, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tbs tomato paste and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Simmer stew: Add the chickpeas, tomatoes and 180ml (¾ cup) water to the pan and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins. Add the zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, for 6-8 mins until the veggies are tender and the sauce is slightly reduced.

Make feta dippers: Meanwhile, cut the rolls in half. Put on the lined tray, cut side up. Drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil, crumble over half the feta and scatter with ½ tsp dried oregano. Bake for 5-7 mins until lightly toasted.
Serve up: Stir 2 tsp honey into the stew. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the chickpea stew among bowls and crumble over the remaining feta. Serve with the feta dippers and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Only 300g (3½ cups) eggplant is needed for this recipe, so if your eggplant looks very large, you may want to check this. Either weigh it or fill a measuring jug with the chopped eggplant for a quick way to measure.
